# Vendored front-end assets

Served from our own origin so pages make no requests to Google Fonts or jsDelivr
(those requests hand the visitor's IP to a third party; see the privacy policy).

| Path | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap-icons/` | bootstrap-icons 1.11.3 (`font/`) | MIT |
| `inter/` | @fontsource-variable/inter 5.0.18, latin + latin-ext | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `chart.umd.min.js` | chart.js 4.4.3 (`dist/chart.umd.min.js`) | MIT |
| `googlemaps-markerclusterer/` | @googlemaps/markerclusterer | Apache 2.0 (see its LICENSE) |

To upgrade, download the same files for the new version and replace them here.
